sets/armor:gww:6014/notes.text:
Warrior Ascalon armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor and it is also available in the Factions campaign. It can only be crafted up to armor rating 59 in Prophecies, but can be crafted in Factions up to max armor rating. The helm is only available without attribute bonus in Prophecies, but with any warrior attribute in Factions.

There is no prestige version of Ascalon armor.

Note: The starter helm is named "Recruit's Cap" and the rest of the starter pieces are named "Ringmail".

sets/armor:gww:66982/notes.text:
Chaos Gloves are a prestige glove art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.




* Similar to all Mesmer gloves, the Mesmer Chaos Gloves only come up to the wrist.
* If you use an Expert Salvage Kit on the gloves, they will salvage into one of the following:
** 30-40 Piles of Glittering Dust, 2-3 Globs of Ectoplasm
** 25-39 Globs of Ectoplasm
** Piles of Glittering Dust.

=== Coloring notes ===
* When dyed certain colors, there is an extension of the glow from the hand for some female characters.
* Part of the glow is generated through post-processing effects, which many people turn off (either because their system performs better or to avoid changes to the screen as a result being drunk).
* Black (and to a lesser extent silver) dye can dim the glow of the gloves by decreasing the distance of the colored aura from the arm (the color of the arm does not change).
When Chaos Gloves are viewed through a semi-transparent surface, such as in water or under an Ooze, they disappear, making your character appear to not have hands.
If a character cycles between their chaos gloves and another pair of gloves at a semi-fast rate, the chaos gloves will appear with an orange shaded-in box around them for a few milliseconds.

offers/offer:66982:255ae60a80df2d67/note.text:
Chaos Gloves are a prestige glove art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.




* Similar to all Mesmer gloves, the Mesmer Chaos Gloves only come up to the wrist.
* If you use an Expert Salvage Kit on the gloves, they will salvage into one of the following:
** 30-40 Piles of Glittering Dust, 2-3 Globs of Ectoplasm
** 25-39 Globs of Ectoplasm
** Piles of Glittering Dust.

=== Coloring notes ===
* When dyed certain colors, there is an extension of the glow from the hand for some female characters.
* Part of the glow is generated through post-processing effects, which many people turn off (either because their system performs better or to avoid changes to the screen as a result being drunk).
* Black (and to a lesser extent silver) dye can dim the glow of the gloves by decreasing the distance of the colored aura from the arm (the color of the arm does not change).
When Chaos Gloves are viewed through a semi-transparent surface, such as in water or under an Ooze, they disappear, making your character appear to not have hands.
If a character cycles between their chaos gloves and another pair of gloves at a semi-fast rate, the chaos gloves will appear with an orange shaded-in box around them for a few milliseconds.

About the crafter; for the Winds of Change NPC, see Oroku (Ministry of Purity).

Oroku crafts armor for core professions using the Krytan armor art and Factions professions using the Imperial armor art. Oroku also crafts Monk, Necromancer and Mesmer Prophecies headgear art as well as Elementalist auras. All armor is crafted with a blank insignia slot.

armorers/armorer:gww:1312/notes.text:
Morbach crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Kurzick armor art. Morbach also crafts Elementalist auras.
All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

Kurzick armor requires the rare crafting material Amber Chunk.

armorers/armorer:gww:7085/notes.text:
Tateos crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Luxon armor art. Tateos also crafts Elementalist Auras. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

Luxon armor requires the rare crafting material Jadeite.

armorers/armorer:gww:63869/notes.text: Brett is an Armorer for the Ebon Vanguard. He only offers his services for players who have attained the rank of Shadow Agent.

armorers/armorer:gww:63269/notes.text: Radi crafts Norn armor for all professions, as well as Highlander Woad and Norn Woad. He will only craft armor for characters who reach the fifth Norn rank, Slayer of Wurms. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

armorers/armorer:gww:25813/notes.text:
The Eternal Forgemaster crafts prestige armor for all professions. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot. In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to appear in the Fissure of Woe players must finish the following quest:
*The Eternal Forgemaster
In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to craft armor for players, the following quests must be completed as well:
*Defend the Temple of War
*Restore the Temple of War
*If he dies, your team will be kicked from the Fissure of Woe. He will not be threatened by new spawns after completion of Defend the Temple of War, however nearby mobs could be accidentally lured towards him.
*This NPC has a miniature version.

armorers/armorer:gww:6967/notes.text: Morgren crafts armor for each of the core professions. Morgren and Seifred are the first crafters who craft maximum armor rating armor in Prophecies.

armorers/armorer:gww:27022/notes.text: The Keeper of Armor crafts prestige armor for core and Nightfall professions using the Primeval armor art. Each armor piece has an empty slot for adding an insignia. Headgear includes an attribute +1 bonus.

armorers/armorer:gww:6981/notes.text: Moon Ahn crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Shing Jea armor art and also the Elementalist auras art. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

armorers/armorer:gww:7046/notes.text:
About the armorer; for the special event collector, see Seiji (collector).

Seiji crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Shing Jea armor art. Seiji also crafts Elementalist auras. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

armorers/armorer:gww:7049/notes.text: Lain crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Shing Jea armor art. Lain also crafts Elementalist auras. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot.

armorers/armorer:gww:7054/notes.text: Ryoko crafts armor for core and Factions professions using the Shing Jea armor art. Ryoko also crafts Elementalist auras.

armorers/armorer:gww:34717/notes.text: Ahamid crafts prestige armor for core and Nightfall professions. Ahamid will only appear in the Command Post after the completion of the quest Building the Base: Prisoners of War.

armorers/armorer:gww:7071/notes.text: Voldo the Exotic crafts armor for core professions using the Tyrian armor art and Factions professions using the Exotic armor art. Voldo also crafts Ranger, Monk, Necromancer and Mesmer Prophecies headgear art and also Elementalist auras. All armor is crafted with a blank insignia slot.

armorers/armorer:gww:94302/notes.text:
Jolvor Stoneforge is an armorsmith in Boreal Station offering basic max armor.
*This NPC was added in the 6th December 2007 update to provide a cheaper source of maxed armor within the Guild Wars Eye of the North expansion.

armorers/armorer:gww:34722/notes.text: Mateneh crafts the prestige Vabbian Armor for core, Factions and Nightfall professions.

armorers/armorer:gww:25808/notes.text: Wei Qi crafts prestige armor for Factions professions using the ascended Exotic armor art. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot. Fellow armorers Koumei and Maiya are found next to Wei Qi.

armorers/armorer:gww:25811/notes.text: Maiya crafts prestige armor for Factions professions using the ascended Imperial armor art. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot. Fellow armorers Koumei and Wei Qi can be found next to Maiya.
